Issue Vaccination Certificate.description: Issues a W3C Verifiable Credential, e.g. a vaccination certificate after a dose is recorded.

Issue Benefit Eligibility Credential.description: Issues a credential proving a household is enrolled in a social protection programme.

Revoke Credential.description: Revokes a credential, e.g. when a certificate was issued in error.

Get Credential.description: Gets a credential by id as JSON.
Get Credential.code:
// Fetch a credential by id.
getCredential($.data.credentialId); // e.g. 'did:rcw:123abc'

Download Credential PDF.description: Downloads a credential rendered with a template, e.g. a printable certificate.

Search Credentials By Subject.description: Finds credentials issued to a subject, optionally by a given issuer.

Verify Credential.description: Verifies a credential's signature and status.
Verify Credential.code:
// Check that a credential is valid and not revoked.
get(`credentials/${$.data.credentialId}/verify`);
